label: Folding forward through SSA
subgoals: Mark each operand as a known constant or unknown
Evaluate operations whose operands are all constants
Substitute the folded constant into later uses

label: Algebraic identities
subgoals: Apply annihilator identities such as v times 0 equals 0
Count the temporaries that end up constant

label: Branches and sparse conditional propagation
subgoals: Fold the branch condition when its operands are constant
Mark only the edges that can execute
Meet phi inputs from executable predecessors only
